# Baseline migration versions -- ground truth as of 2026-08-01, derived from
# the ACTUAL committed contents of supabase/migrations/ (ls, not a re-run of
# scripts/migrate-legacy-to-cli.mjs's git-add-date heuristic).
#
# Why not just re-run the script: doing so this pass (dry-run only, verified
# safe) surfaced a real idempotency bug -- for at least 3 already-baselined
# files (the RLS gap-closure migration, and the two nycmaid-routing-reconcile
# migrations renumbered 061->063 on 2026-07-12), the script's git-add-date
# lookup (`git log --diff-filter=A`, no rename-detection) fails to find their
# real history in this worktree and falls back to "now" -- producing a
# DIFFERENT timestamp on every run than the one already committed under.
# Re-running the script for real right now would have written 3 duplicate
# migration files for content already tracked under other version numbers.
# See docs/adr/0008-migration-tool-cutover.md's 2026-08-01 addendum for the
# full writeup; NOT fixed this pass, flagged for a dedicated pass instead.
#
# These 163 versions are the hand-run .sql pile (+ 1 previously-orphaned
# file recovered from a disconnected duplicate Supabase CLI project, see the
# same addendum) converted to Supabase-CLI format and assumed already live
# in prod as of the 2026-07-28 cutover (docs/adr/0008-migration-tool-cutover.md).
# Marking them "applied" in the CLI's own tracking table
# (supabase_migrations.schema_migrations) is a separate, gated, NOT-yet-
# executed step -- requires Jeff's explicit go per the ADR, same approval
# class as any other prod write. 1 additional file
# (20260728194629_rls_gap_closure_post_july15.sql) exists in this same
# directory but is deliberately EXCLUDED from this list -- it is genuinely
# pending, not yet applied to prod, and stays that way until `supabase db
# push` runs it for real after Jeff's go.
#
# Command to run once approved:
supabase migration repair --status applied 20260309195434 20260309195435 20260311050820 20260311060110 20260312024622 20260312024623 20260324001923 20260420021012 20260420021013 20260420021014
